# External validation: CLEF TAR 2019 (2017–2018 topics, 40 Cochrane reviews) — criteria: objectives and selection criteria

Generated by `benchmark/external/evaluate.py`; plan fixed beforehand in `PLAN.md`. Do not edit by hand.

- CLEF TAR commit `dbc13d02bb3e`; every include plus up to 200 other records per review (a seeded sample, weighted to the review's size)
- 302,720 records in the 40 reviews, 8,739 asked, 849 final includes (only final includes kept whole); 39 reviews have at least one final include
- Thresholds from SYNERGY+, not retuned: 0.06 (safe, frozen), 0.08 (safe, corrected), 0.17 (98%, frozen), 0.26 (95%, frozen)
- Model jev-1.13.0, 8,738 calls, US$ 0.365; answers sha256 `ce51e8fc77ee`
- Records without an abstract or not in PubMed (never below the threshold): 871 asked records, 26 of them final includes

**Pre-specified verdict: failure** — not every review with an include kept at least 98% of its final includes at 0.06.

## Secondary

- Score alone (no abstract rule) at 0.06: pooled recall 99.9%, reviews keeping every include 38/39
- Title/abstract includes: not measured (only final includes were kept whole in this set)
- Ranking (weighted): median WSS@95 0.886, median WSS@100 0.934, median AUC 0.983
- Final includes below 0.06: 1
  - CD011134 (Blood CEA levels for detecting recurrent colorectal cancer): PMID 16649724, score 0.02, titled "Amount of left ventricular hypertrophy determines the plasma N-terminal pro-brain natriuretic peptide level in patients with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and normal left ventricular ejection fraction."
